title: Multi-Clause Counterfactual Stacking in Scientific Dilemmas

sections.title: Ha ... volna and Its Results
sections.content: You know the past counterfactual from B1 Unit 39: *ha* + past tense + *volna* in the condition, and *volna* again in the result (*Ha tudtam volna, eljöttem volna*). A past condition can also have a result that holds today (B1 Unit 70): *Ha nem építették volna meg a gyárat, ma nem lenne itt munkahely.* Here several such clauses follow one another, to trace a chain of causes and effects.

sections.title: Even If It Had Happened
sections.content: You know *még ha ... is* from B2 Unit 53. With *volna* it grants a condition that did not happen and says the result would have been the same: *Még ha figyelmeztették volna is a tudósokat, akkor sem hallgattak volna rájuk.* The past possibility *meg lehetett volna előzni* ('it could have been prevented') is known from B1 Unit 39 and B2 Unit 15.

sections.title: Counterfactual Patterns
rows: Ha időben észrevették volna a hibát, a gép nem romlott volna el. (If they had noticed the error in time, the machine would not have broken down.)
Ha nem építették volna meg a gyárat, ma nem lenne itt munkahely. (If they had not built the factory, there would be no jobs here today.)
még ha ... volna is, akkor sem ... volna
Még ha figyelmeztették volna is a tudósokat, akkor sem hallgattak volna rájuk. (Even if they had warned the scientists, they would not have listened to them.)
A balesetet meg lehetett volna előzni. (The accident could have been prevented.)

items.spanish: Ha a mérnökök időben észrevették volna a hibát, a gép nem romlott volna el.
items.english: Had the engineers noticed the error in time, the machine would not have broken down.

items.spanish: Még ha a mérnökök megcsinálták volna is a szimulációt, a hibát akkor sem lehetett volna teljesen elkerülni.
items.english: Even if the engineers had done the simulation, the error could not have been completely avoided anyway.

items.spanish: Ha nem építették volna meg a gyárat, ma nem lenne itt munkahely.
items.english: Had they not built the factory, there would be no jobs here today.

items.spanish: Ha jobban figyeltek volna, elkerülhették volna a kockázatot.
items.english: Had they paid more attention, they could have avoided the risk.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: In the condition and in the result, *volna* follows the past-tense verb: *ha tudtam volna, eljöttem volna*. For a result that holds today use the present conditional (*lenne*, *dolgoznánk*).
